source.stage_a_origin: Ada /home2/karma/duan-verify/out/phase1/f5-dir2/f5_stage_a.pt (the 404-feature direction-swap run of the F5 study)

baselines.A: activation correlation, log FP activation, firing rate, log residual norm
baselines.B: A plus matched and random-direction sensitivity measured with independent directions
baselines.gradient: first-order (forward-mode) prediction of the effect of the FP edit at the native Q context and Q suffix (arXiv 2610.15850), mandatory

spec.bootstrap_unit: source-sentence clusters resampled jointly across languages, features crossed
spec.cell_meaning: prefix state / suffix state of the cached layer-12 residual and the layers above; the edit is the fixed FP decoder contribution at the FP-active positions; Q/Q-native subtracts the quantized state's own activation; every cell subtracts its own unedited baseline
spec.contexts: the F5 rule: per feature the M dev sentences with the largest FP activation among those where it is positive (any language of the dev pool); a context is one dev sentence

external_panel.rules: first parquet shard per language, distinct articles by SHA-256 order of the article id, passages of 64 to 128 tokens cut at sentence ends, exact and normalized duplicates of FLORES lines removed; zho_Hans passages with any filter character are dropped; a language with too few passages is recorded as missing, never replaced
external_panel.zho_Hans_filter_characters: 這個們來說為與對會時學國將後開長關點從還麼種現發裡當問應頭見無動經讓樣實體電機車東書氣門馬歲親邊運進

spec.floor_definition: 95th percentile over the calibration contexts of the norm of D[INT16] minus D[FP] at the same features, directions and contexts (same batch regime and readout); the repeated-batch pseudo-state of F5 if that is exactly zero; eligible: FP effect norm above 5 times the floor; fixed from calibration contexts only

hypotheses.A3: expectation after Chang et al. (EMNLP 2025, sections 6.1 and 6.2): the median over languages of |C| > |W| at INT4 and at INT6 in the group-level effect; confirming it alone is not a contribution
hypotheses.H1: native effect error requires more than activation drift or a scalar change of perturbation size (tested against magnitude, residual norm and generic-direction baselines)
hypotheses.H2: the crossed background and suffix contrasts explain a reproducible part of the error, with the interaction measured
hypotheses.H3: generic sensitivity predicts some transfer error and feature- or context-specific variation may remain
hypotheses.H4: per-context transfer differs from similarity of averaged fingerprints (same feature-context pairs)

spec.primary_endpoint: normalized per-context transfer error ||D[Q,Q]-D[FP,FP]|| / (||D[FP,FP]|| + floor); also unnormalized error, norm ratio, cosine and signed loss change
spec.random_directions: norm-matched to the real decoder direction and orthogonal to it; auxiliary calibration directions, not independent samples
spec.ridge_selection: feature-group folds inside the calibration half; standardization fitted on calibration only; never pooled across INT4 and INT6

split.rule: per language by SHA-256 of 'salt:feature id', the first ceil(n/2) features are calibration, the rest held out; the FLORES source sentence (dev index modulo 997) is the cluster

stored_statistics.contents: 5x5 Gram of the centered-logit effect vectors accumulated in float64 from float32 logits; signed loss change of each cell; edited positions; positions where the feature is active in the state; unedited hybrid loss of each cell; per feature also the Gram of the sum over contexts (averaged fingerprint)
stored_statistics.per: feature, direction, context and quantized state

utility_rule.interval: paired cluster bootstrap excluding zero improvement
